description: Get a single audience member (subscriber) by email or subscriber_hash, including status, merge fields, tags and stats. REST: GET /lists/{list_id}/members/{subscriber_hash} (email → MD5 hash).

email.description: Member email address — MD5-hashed (lowercased) into the subscriber_hash for you.

subscriberHash.description: The subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercased email) or contact id, if you have it instead of `email`.

name: mailchimp_get_member
title: Get member
